Morning, all. I'd like to hold our CSE455 staff meeting next week. My week is packed, so the only openings I have are short ones:

- Mon Nov 23, 14:00-14:30
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30

Both are half-hour slots. Can you each tell me which of those works, and whether anyone has a preference to make it a full hour (I'd have to move something of mine to do that)? Also flag anything of yours next week I should know about for the course.

Morning. Both slots work for me — I have nothing at Mon 14:00-14:30 or Wed 13:00-13:30.

On the full hour: I can't do a full hour in either slot without moving something of my own. Mon 14:00-15:00 runs into my research group meeting at 14:30, and Wed 13:00-14:00 runs into my study group at 13:30. If you want the hour, Wednesday costs me less — I can shift the study group, whereas Monday's research group meeting isn't mine to move. So: either half-hour, and if it becomes an hour, Wed 13:00-14:00.

For the course next week, my CSE455 commitments are: office hours Mon 09:00-10:00 and Fri 09:00-10:00, quiz sections Mon 10:30-11:30, Thu 14:30-15:20 and Fri 10:00-10:50, plus Thursday office hours 13:20-14:30. Nothing there needs your attention unless you want to change the quiz sections — but note Thursday's office hours and quiz section are back to back, so I'd rather not take anything else on Thursday afternoon.

Slight preference for Wednesday if it's all the same to everyone else.

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. I'm finalising my calendar for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27) and want to be sure I'm not missing anything official. Could you confirm any lectures, seminars or university meetings involving me or CSE455 that week, with times? In particular, is anything scheduled outside 09:00-17:00 or added to the usual weekly pattern?

Morning. For me only the Wednesday slot works:

- Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 — free, I'm available.
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00-14:30 — clashes with my Study group (13:50-14:50), so I can't take it.

On the full hour: I'd keep it at 30 minutes. Wednesday 13:30-14:20 I have the CSE455 quiz section, so 13:00-14:00 isn't possible on my side; and Monday 14:00-15:00 runs into the same Study group. If the hour matters more than the day I can look at moving the study group, but I'd rather not.

Things of mine next week you should know about for the course: CSE455 office hours Tue 15:30-16:20 and Wed 10:30-12:00, quiz sections Tue 16:20-17:00 and Wed 13:30-14:20. Nothing else course-related is in flux right now.

Thanks, Sarah — and thanks John. Noted on Wednesday 13:30 being your quiz section, Sarah, and on your Thursday afternoon load, John.

Priya, still waiting on you for the two half-hour slots (Mon Nov 23 14:00-14:30, Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30) and anything of yours next week for the course.

Leaning Wednesday 13:00-13:30 unless you tell me Monday is better for you — Sarah can only do Wednesday, and a full hour would cost her quiz section, so I'm not taking it.

Hello Professor Alvarez. Everything involving you or CSE455 next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), as officially scheduled:

**Monday**
- 09:00-10:00 Curriculum committee — you
- 09:00-10:00 CSE455 office hours
- 10:30-11:30 CSE455 quiz section
- 13:00-14:00 Colloquium — you
- 14:30-15:20 CSE455 lecture — you
- 15:20-16:30 Faculty meeting — you
- 16:30-17:00 CSE455 office hours (also listed for you)

**Tuesday**
- 09:00-10:30 CSE455 lecture — you
- 10:30-11:00 Faculty meeting — you
- 12:20-13:30 CSE455 office hours — you
- 13:30-14:20 CSE455 quiz section
- 13:30-14:20 Thesis committee — you
- 15:30-16:20 CSE455 office hours
- 16:20-17:00 CSE455 quiz section
- 16:30-17:00 Guest lecture prep — you

**Wednesday**
- 09:00-10:00 CSE455 quiz section
- 09:00-10:00 Thesis committee — you
- 10:30-12:00 CSE455 office hours
- 13:30-14:20 CSE455 quiz section
- 13:30-14:30 Guest lecture prep — you
- 14:30-16:00 Department seminar — you

**Thursday**
- 09:00-09:50 Guest lecture prep — you
- 09:50-11:10 Department seminar — you
- 13:20-14:30 CSE455 office hours
- 13:40-14:40 Curriculum committee — you
- 14:30-15:20 CSE455 quiz section
- 15:30-17:00 Colloquium — you

**Friday**
- 09:00-10:00 CSE455 office hours
- 09:00-10:00 Curriculum committee — you
- 10:00-10:50 CSE455 quiz section
- 12:30-13:20 Colloquium — you
- 13:20-14:30 CSE455 lecture — you
- 14:30-15:20 Faculty meeting — you
- 15:20-17:00 CSE455 office hours (also listed for you)

Nothing falls outside 09:00-17:00, and nothing has been added to or cancelled from the usual weekly pattern. I don't have your private appointments, so this is only the official schedule.

Noted, Sarah. So Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is common ground for the two of us — and since you have the quiz section at 13:30-14:20, the full hour isn't on the table for Wednesday either. That settles my earlier offer: I'd rather keep the study group where it is and stay at 30 minutes on Wednesday.

Waiting on Priya's answer, then I'm happy to book Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 unless someone objects.

Thank you — that's what I needed. Two things I want to flag:

1. Thursday 13:20-14:30 (CSE455 office hours) and 13:40-14:40 (Curriculum committee) overlap for me. Which is the official one? I'll be in the committee meeting otherwise, and the office hours need to be covered.
2. Tuesday 13:30-14:20 CSE455 quiz section and 13:30-14:20 Thesis committee also overlap, and so do Wednesday 09:00-10:00 (CSE455 quiz section / Thesis committee) and Friday 09:00-10:00 (CSE455 office hours / Curriculum committee). Same question for each.

For my own planning, I'm putting a CSE455 staff meeting at Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30, which the official schedule leaves clear. Nothing else needed from you.
Wednesday 13:00-13:30 works for me — agreed, no full hour. I'll hold that slot and book it once Priya confirms.

Priya — quick one, sorry for the short notice. I'm trying to set our CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Sarah can only do Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30; John can do either that or Mon Nov 23 14:00-14:30. Does Wed 13:00-13:30 work for you, and can you tell me what you have on next week for the course (office hours, quiz sections) so I have it straight?

Morning, Alvarez. Both slots work for me: I'm free Mon 14:00-14:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30.

On the full hour — both options cost me something. Mon 14:00-15:00 runs into my CSE444 lecture at 14:30, which I shouldn't miss. Wed 13:00-14:00 runs into my research group meeting at 13:30, which I could join late or skip once. So if you do want the hour, Wednesday is the cheaper of the two for me. But I don't need the hour: a half hour is fine by me if it is for everyone else.

For the course next week, my CSE455 commitments are: office hours Mon 16:30-17:00, Tue 12:20-13:30 and Fri 15:20-17:00; quiz sections Tue 13:30-14:20 and Wed 09:00-10:00. Tuesday is the tight day — my office hours run straight into the quiz section, so I'd rather not take anything else on Tuesday midday. Wednesday morning quiz section is followed by grading at 10:30, which is fine.

John: noted on Thursday afternoon — no objection from me to keeping the quiz sections as they are.

Both entries are in the official schedule; nothing in it marks one of an overlapping pair as the one that takes precedence, and I have no record of a cancellation or a replacement for either. I can't decide that for you — the department would have to say which is official in each case.

For reference, the overlaps you list are all listed as I gave them:
- Thu: CSE455 office hours 13:20-14:30 / Curriculum committee 13:40-14:40
- Tue: CSE455 quiz section 13:30-14:20 / Thesis committee 13:30-14:20
- Wed: CSE455 quiz section 09:00-10:00 / Thesis committee 09:00-10:00
- Fri: CSE455 office hours 09:00-10:00 / Curriculum committee 09:00-10:00

Noted your CSE455 staff meeting Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 — the official schedule is clear at that time. It's your own arrangement, so I won't put it on the official calendar.
Good — 30 minutes it is, Wednesday. Just hold your calendars; I'll do the booking once Priya answers, and I'll confirm here with the slot in writing.

Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 works for me — put me down for it. (I posted the same to the thread a moment ago; sorry for the overlap.)

My CSE455 commitments next week: office hours Mon 16:30-17:00, Tue 12:20-13:30 and Fri 15:20-17:00; quiz sections Tue 13:30-14:20 and Wed 09:00-10:00. The only thing worth flagging is Tuesday midday: my office hours run straight into the quiz section, so I'd rather not add anything there. Wednesday 13:00 is clear for me — my research group meeting starts at 13:30, so the half hour is all I can give, and a full hour would cost me that.

If you'd like, I can book Wed 13:00-13:30 in my calendar and the thread can treat it as fixed.

Booked and confirmed: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00-13:30**, in my calendar — half an hour, no full hour, so nobody has to move anything. Sarah, you're clear straight into your 13:30 quiz section; John, your study group stays put; Priya, no cost to your Wednesday.

Thank you for the trade-offs each of you laid out — that made it easy. Agenda items to me by Monday evening, please.

Also, on the overlaps in the official schedule: the department confirms they can't tell me which of a clashing pair takes precedence. So I'm going to treat them as mine to triage, and I'll say here what I decide rather than let anyone guess:

- Thu 13:20-14:30 office hours vs 13:40-14:40 Curriculum committee — I'll be at the committee; office hours that afternoon run 13:20-13:40 only. John, that clips your Thursday afternoon rather than adding to it.
- Tue 13:30-14:20 quiz section vs Thesis committee — Priya, that's your quiz section; I'll be in the thesis committee and you cover it.
- Wed 09:00-10:00 quiz section vs Thesis committee — Priya, yours again; I'll be at the thesis committee.
- Fri 09:00-10:00 office hours vs Curriculum committee — I'll be in the committee; office hours start at 10:00 instead.

Tell me if any of that puts you somewhere you can't be.

Yes — book it, please. Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 is fixed and already in my calendar. It ends on the dot so you make your research group at 13:30.

One consequence for you out of the official schedule's clashing entries: Tue 13:30-14:20 quiz section and Wed 09:00-10:00 quiz section both fall against my committee meetings, and since they're yours to cover, I'll be at the committees — so those two quiz sections are yours alone. Your Tuesday 12:20-13:30 office hours running into the 13:30 quiz section stays as it is; I'm not adding anything to Tuesday midday.

Agenda items for Wednesday to me by Monday evening.

Priya — that's all of us then: both slots free for you, so Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is the one that works for the whole group, half hour, no moving anything. Thanks for the Tuesday-midday note; I'll keep that in mind before I ask you for anything there.

Alvarez — Wednesday it is, and I've put it in my calendar as a hold: Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30, CSE455 staff meeting. I'll treat your written confirmation here as final and adjust if it changes. For the record, nothing in my week needs moving for it — my study group starts at 13:30, so it's tight but fine.

Thanks — Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30 is in my calendar as CSE455 staff meeting.

None of your triage puts me somewhere I can't be: Thursday afternoon I'm in Reading group 12:50-14:10 and Focus 14:10-15:10, so the clipped Thursday office hours don't touch me, and the Tue/Wed quiz-section and committee overlaps are Priya's and John's, not mine. My CSE455 commitments for the week stand as I posted them (office hours Tue 15:30-16:20, Wed 10:30-12:00; quiz sections Tue 16:20-17:00, Wed 13:30-14:20).

Agenda item from me by Monday evening.

That's final — Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30, CSE455 staff meeting. It ends at 13:30 sharp so you and Priya both make your 13:30 commitments.

One thing from my side, out of the official schedule's clashing entries: Thursday my office hours and the Curriculum committee overlap. I'll be at the committee, so Thursday office hours run 13:20-13:40 only — shorter, not additional. I won't add anything to your Thursday afternoon.

Agenda items by Monday evening, please.

Good — Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30, confirmed. Note Wednesday is tight for you: my staff meeting ends at 13:30 and your quiz section starts at 13:30, so come ready to leave on time; if you want to send your agenda item in writing instead of raising it, that's fine by me.

Agenda by Monday evening. Thank you.

Understood — Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30, in my calendar, and I'll be ready to leave at 13:30 for the quiz section. I'll send my agenda item in writing by Monday evening so the meeting doesn't need to run long for my sake.

Alvarez — your triage works for me on all four lines, nothing puts me anywhere I can't be:

- Tue 13:30-14:20 quiz section (vs Thesis committee): mine, I'll cover it. It runs straight off my 12:20-13:30 office hours as it already does — that's the one tight stretch of my week, so no change needed.
- Wed 09:00-10:00 quiz section (vs Thesis committee): mine, I'll cover it. Grading at 10:30 follows it, which is fine.
- The Thursday and Friday office-hour changes aren't mine to carry.

Also confirmed: Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30 CSE455 staff meeting is in my calendar. Agenda item from me by Monday evening.

John, Sarah — nothing I need from either of you for this; the quiz sections stay as posted (Tue 13:30-14:20, Wed 09:00-10:00).

Wednesday Nov 25 13:00-13:30 is in my calendar — thanks for the confirmation.

On the overlaps, three of the four don't touch me, but Friday does, so please resolve that one before it bites:

- Thu 13:20-14:30 office hours vs Curriculum committee: fine on my side. I read that as my office hours being cut to 13:20-13:40 — that leaves me with less, not more. My 14:30 quiz section and 15:20 grading are untouched. Say the word and I'll record it as 13:20-13:40.
- Fri 09:00-10:00 office hours vs Curriculum committee: this one is a problem. Friday morning I have office hours 09:00-10:00 and the CSE455 quiz section 10:00-10:50 back to back. If office hours start at 10:00 instead, they sit right on top of the quiz section, and I can't hold both. Either the quiz section needs covering that morning, or office hours move to a slot that doesn't touch 10:00-10:50 — after that I'm in grading 10:50-12:00, lunch 12:00-12:50, then focus, research group and reading group from 12:50, so Friday has no easy gap.
- Tue 13:30-14:20 and Wed 09:00-10:00 quiz sections: those are Priya's, not mine. Nothing from me there.

Otherwise your triage is fine by me. I'll send agenda items by Monday evening, once I know how Friday morning lands.

John — agreed that Friday is the one that bites, and the fix depends on something the note leaves open: "Fri 09:00-10:00 office hours" isn't named. If it's Alvarez's own office hours moving to 10:00, nothing of yours changes. If it's yours, then your quiz section 10:00-10:50 and the moved office hours are the same hour and one of them has to give.

That one isn't mine to cover, either way: I'm in Advisor 1:1 09:00-10:00 and Study group 10:00-11:30 on Friday, so I have no Friday morning space at all.

Alvarez — can you say whose office hours those Friday ones are, and if it's John's, whether the quiz section or the office hours gives? His Thursday reading (cut to 13:20-13:40) matches mine.

On Friday, for what it's worth while Alvarez decides: I can't cover the 10:00-10:50 quiz section. My Friday is Reading group 09:00-10:10, then Focus: CSE452 lab 10:10-11:00, so I'm occupied straight across that stretch. Nothing else in the triage touches my week.

John — you're right, and I was wrong on Friday. I over-stepped: those 09:00-10:00 office hours on Friday are yours, not mine, so I had no business moving them to 10:00 and dropping them onto your quiz section. Withdrawn.

Same for Thursday: your office hours stay 13:20-14:30 as posted, not clipped to 13:20-13:40. The clash there is only on paper, between your hours and my Curriculum committee. Hold your hours in full; I'm in the committee 13:40-14:40 and that's my problem, not yours.

The general rule from here, so nobody has to guess again: where an entry is mine — lectures, seminars, faculty meetings, colloquia, the curriculum and thesis committees, the PhD and thesis 1:1s — I attend it as scheduled. Where an entry is one of yours — office hours, quiz sections, grading — you hold it in full, as posted, and I don't touch it. My calendar carries the version I attend; nothing in your week changes because of the overlaps.

So: Friday morning is untouched. Office hours 09:00-10:00, quiz section 10:00-10:50, grading after — exactly as it was.
Noted, Sarah — so neither of us can take Friday 10:00-10:50 either way, which leaves only Alvarez or John. Alvarez, it's your call to make; I'll stay out of it beyond that.

Priya — the Friday 09:00-10:00 office hours are John's, not mine; mine that morning are the Curriculum committee. And nothing is moving: office hours stay 09:00-10:00, quiz section 10:00-10:50, as posted. There is nothing to cover, because nothing was ever really in conflict — the office hours are John's and the Curriculum committee is mine, and we are simply in two places at once on paper.

So my earlier line about Friday office hours starting at 10:00 is withdrawn. Sarah, you won't be asked to cover anything.

Where the exercise lands: I attend the entries that are mine — lectures, seminars, faculty meetings, colloquia, curriculum and thesis committees, the thesis and PhD 1:1s. Entries that are John's, Sarah's or Priya's — office hours, quiz sections, grading — stay in full, as posted, untouched by me. Thursday office hours stay 13:20-14:30 for John. Friday morning is as it was.

The only change to anyone's week is the staff meeting: Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30. Agenda items to me by Monday evening; John, yours can come once this is settled, which it now is.

Clear rule, Alvarez — and it matches what I said earlier, so nothing changes on my side: my quiz sections (Tue 13:30-14:20, Wed 09:00-10:00) and office hours stand in full as posted, and my calendar is up to date with the Wednesday staff meeting. Agenda item from me by Monday evening.

To help narrow it: those Friday 09:00-10:00 office hours aren't mine. My Friday has no CSE455 office hours at all (Reading group 09:00-10:10, Focus: CSE452 lab 10:10-11:00), and my CSE455 hours are Tue 15:30-16:20 and Wed 10:30-12:00. John listed Fri 09:00-10:00 office hours as his, so I read the Friday clash as his to resolve — Alvarez can confirm.

Priya, Sarah — thanks, and you're right that the note leaves the owner unnamed. From the official schedule the Friday 09:00-10:00 entry reads as mine: CSE455 office hours, the ones I posted as my own. So I'm treating it as mine until Alvarez or the department says otherwise, and the conflict stands as I flagged it — moved office hours 10:00 would land exactly on my 10:00-10:50 quiz section. Noted that neither of you has Friday morning space; I'm not asking either of you to cover it.

I've asked the department office to say whose entry that Friday block is and how the clash resolves, so we're not guessing.

Understood and agreed: my week is unchanged apart from the staff meeting on Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30, and my office hours and quiz sections stand in full as posted. Agenda item to Alvarez by Monday evening.

John — it's settled, and you're right that it's yours. Friday 09:00-10:00 office hours are yours, they stay at 09:00-10:00, and the quiz section stays 10:00-10:50. Nothing moves. My earlier "office hours start at 10:00" was a mistake on my part — I was treating an entry of yours as mine — and I've withdrawn it.

Same on Thursday: your office hours stay 13:20-14:30, uncut. I'm in the Curriculum committee 13:40-14:40 and that overlap is mine to carry, not yours to surrender anything for.

No need to chase the department on this; I asked them about the overlaps earlier and they won't rule on precedence. The rule I'm applying is the one I posted: entries that are mine I attend; entries that are yours, Sarah's and Priya's stay in full as posted. You can stop holding anything in reserve for Friday.

Agenda item by Monday evening.

John — Alvarez has just settled it above: those Friday 09:00-10:00 office hours are yours, his earlier move to 10:00 is withdrawn, and your Friday morning stands exactly as posted (office hours 09:00-10:00, quiz section 10:00-10:50, grading after). Thursday's 13:20-14:30 also stays in full. So there's nothing left for the department to resolve — no need to wait on their answer.

John — check Alvarez's message just above yours: he's already confirmed the Friday 09:00-10:00 office hours are yours and withdrawn the move to 10:00, so there's nothing left for the department to resolve. Your Friday morning is untouched: office hours 09:00-10:00, quiz section 10:00-10:50. If you've already asked the department, a short note back saying it's settled would save them the work.

Hello — John here, CSE455 TA. Two questions about next week's official schedule, for the record:

1. Whose entry is the Friday 09:00-10:00 CSE455 office hours — mine (TA office hours) or someone else's?
2. Where two official entries clash (e.g. Thu 13:20-14:30 CSE455 office hours vs 13:40-14:40 Curriculum committee), does the department define which takes precedence, or is it for the people involved to settle?

If the answer is that precedence isn't ruled on, just say so and I'll take it as settled.

Hello John.

1. The Friday 09:00-10:00 CSE455 office hours entry is just listed as "CSE455 office hours" — it doesn't name an owner. So I can't confirm it's yours; the schedule as I have it doesn't say who covers it.

2. No — precedence isn't ruled on. Where two official entries clash, both stand as listed, and it's for the people involved to settle. So you can take it as settled that way.

Follow-up, and sorry for the noise: please disregard my two questions — it's been settled inside CSE455. The Friday 09:00-10:00 office hours are mine and stay as posted, and the Thursday overlap is being carried by the person whose entry it is. No action needed from you.

All four overlaps are resolved on my side, and none of them needs anything from you. Where your schedule listed my name and a TA's on the same hour, I attend the entry that is mine and the TA keeps theirs in full, untouched. No cancellations, no replacements, nothing to record. If John asked you whose the Friday 09:00-10:00 office hours are: they're his, and they stay there. Please don't spend time on it.
Understood — noted, and nothing changed on the official schedule. No action on my side.
Understood, Professor Alvarez — nothing to record, no changes, and I won't spend time on it. Friday 09:00-10:00 stays as posted.

Settled, and thanks — Sarah, Priya, you're right that I was a step behind: I asked the department before Alvarez's withdrawal landed, and I've told them to disregard it.

For the record, the department's answer is that the Friday 09:00-10:00 entry names no owner and that they don't rule on precedence at all — both clashing entries stand and it's for the people involved to settle. Which is exactly what we've now done, in writing, here.

So my week: office hours Thu 13:20-14:30 in full, Fri 09:00-10:00 followed by the quiz section 10:00-10:50, grading after — untouched. Staff meeting Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30 is in my calendar. Agenda item to Alvarez by Monday evening.
